gappers.catalyst: Satellogic riding Q2 2026 run: revenue +259% to $15.9M, analyst Moderate Buy consensus.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Satellogic reported Q2 2026 revenue up 259% y/y to $15.9M; stock ran multi-day then pulled back to ~$5.80. Today's gap is a continuation bounce with no fresh named catalyst found.
gappers.why: Post-earnings growth re-rating plus analyst upgrades to Moderate Buy attract momentum buyers.

gappers.catalyst: TORM tanker shares up on oil surge and Middle East/Iran-deal risk.
gappers.catalyst_detail: TORM plc (product tankers) rising with oil prices after Trump declared the Iran deal off/in doubt, lifting Middle East supply-risk premium. Stock ~$38 vs $22 a year ago.
gappers.why: Geopolitical risk raises tanker rates and sentiment; shipping equities trade on freight-rate expectations.
gappers.impact: Volume only ~21K so far; headline-driven and reversible if diplomacy headlines flip. No sector read-through to the space cluster.
gappers.horizon_reason: Geopolitical headline spike, expect fade unless freight rates confirm.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Different sector (energy shipping) so wouldn't crowd space names, but it would use one of 3 weekly slots on a headline trade; foreign-domiciled, wide-ish stop needed vs 2:1 R:R.

gappers.catalyst: Rocket Lab rebounding after post-earnings/offering slide; Cantor reiterated Overweight.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Rocket Lab bounced (+8% to ~$69.89 in one session) from a post-earnings/equity-offering drop after Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated Overweight. Benzinga also noted sympathy moves with the aerospace tape.
gappers.why: Analyst support after offering-driven selloff draws dip buyers; sector momentum in space names.
gappers.impact: Best liquidity of the list (138K). Move is part of a sector-wide space bid (ASTS, LUNR, SATL), so partly beta; offering overhang can cap upside.

gappers.opportunity_cost: Highest-quality candidate here; would compete with ASTS/LUNR for the same space-sector slot and correlation gate (>0.75) likely blocks holding several. Needs stop <~10% to reach 2:1.

gappers.catalyst_detail: AST SpaceMobile has been driven by BlueBird LEO satellite launches (successes and setbacks) and Q2 results focusing on rollout and sales ramp; a 12% move on Sept 4 was launch-related. No new item identified for today.

gappers.horizon_reason: Today's move looks sector sympathy; long-term thesis exists but not confirmed by a new catalyst today.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Overlaps RKLB in sector and correlation; taking it displaces RKLB or a diversifying name. Volatility makes a 10% trail wide relative to a 2:1 target.
